Garlic Butter Spaghetti 🔥 Quick, easy, and dangerously good. Buttery garlic heaven with a hint of spice… Pro Tip: Level it up with chicken, shrimp, or tofu 🫡 Ingredients: -2 shallots, thinly sliced -5 garlic cloves, minced -2 tbsp chili crisp -1 cup of cream or coconut milk, room temperature -1 tbsp soy sauce, optional -1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated -8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice -2 tbsp butter -1 tbsp olive oil -Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, oregano 1. Slice your shallots nice and thin and measure out your seasonings. Bring your cream or coconut milk to room temp so it blends in smoothly later. 2. Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add the shallots and sauté for 8–10 minutes until soft and starting to turn golden. 3. While the shallots are doing their thing, bring a big pot of salted water to a boil and cook your pasta until al dente. Drain, but save some pasta water… it’s liquid gold. Seriously, don’t you dare dump it. Italians everywhere are watching. 4. Once the shallots are soft and sweet, stir in your minced garlic (fresh garlic only - if you pull out that jarred stuff, the FBI will be at your door in minutes 😅) and all the seasonings. Let them bloom for about a minute, then add the chili crisp and give it another quick sauté. 5. Pour in the cream (or coconut milk), stir in the soy sauce if using, and let it simmer for a few minutes to thicken. Add in the grated Parmesan and stir. 6. Toss your pasta in the sauce until fully coated, adding splashes of reserved pasta water as needed to get that perfect silky consistency. 7. Serve hot with an extra spoonful of chili crisp on top for a little heat and a sprinkle of Parmesan and parsley if you’re feelin’ fancy. #dinnerideas #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #pasta

Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

My first cozy recipe of the season had to be a little spooky🤭🎃👻 Save this recipe for later☺️ Creamy Tomato Soup & Vegan Grilled Cheese Ingredients: • 5 ripe tomatoes • 2 bell peppers • 1 onion • 2 whole heads of garlic • 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar • 3 tbsp olive oil • 1-2 cups (240-480 ml) vegetable broth • 1 small bunch fresh basil • Fresh rosemary • Salt & black pepper Grilled cheese: • Bread of choice • Vegan butter • Vegan cheese How to make the soup: 1. Place everything on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, and season with salt and fresh rosemary. 3. Roast at 350°F (180°C) for 40-50 minutes, until soft. 4. Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves out of their skins and transfer everything to a pot. 5. Add fresh basil, black pepper, and 1 cup of vegetable broth, then blend until creamy and smooth. Melt vegan butter in a skillet over medium heat, then add the bread and top with vegan cheese. Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

POV: your dinner is watching you👁️👁️👻😂🤭 Save this recipe for Halloween🎃 Spooky Eyeball Stuffed Shells Ingredients: For the filling: • Vegan ground beef - 12 oz (340 g) • 1 Bell pepper, finely diced • 1 Onion, finely diced • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Tomato paste - 1 tbsp • Tomato sauce - 1/3 cup (80 ml) • Smoked paprika - to taste • Italian seasoning - to taste • Olive oil - 1 tbsp • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the tomato sauce: • Strained tomatoes - 26.5 oz (750 g) • Agave syrup - 1 tsp • Italian seasoning - 1 tsp • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the stuffed shells: • 18 Jumbo pasta shells • 9 Mini vegan mozzarella balls, halved • Black olives - as needed, sliced • Tomato paste - as needed, for the veins • Fresh thyme - optional How to make: 1. Cook the vegan ground beef in olive oil over medium heat, breaking it into very small crumbles with a spatula. 2. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook until softened. Season with smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste. 3. To make the sauce, combine the strained tomatoes, agave syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute. 4. Stir 1/3 cup (80 ml) of the tomato sauce into the filling. 5. Cook the jumbo shells according to package directions until al dente. Drain and let cool just enough to handle. 6. Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Stuff each shell generously with the filling and arrange in the dish. 7. Spoon a little tomato sauce over each shell. 8. Top each shell with half of a mini vegan mozzarella ball and a slice of black olive to create the pupil. Grease a loaf pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. Mash the bananas in a medium bowl until smooth. Add the melted butter and Greek yogurt (or sour cream) and whisk until combined. Add the baking soda, cinnamon, salt, and flour, then gently fold everything together just until no dry streaks remain. Do not overmix. Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Shrimp Stuffed Shells Ingredients 1. 20 jumbo pasta shells 2. 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 cup ricotta cheese 6. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 7. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 8. 1 large egg 9. 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 10. 2 tbsp cream cheese 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 16. 1 tbsp lemon juice 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Cook the jumbo pasta shells in salted boiling water until al dente. 3. Drain the shells and rinse them with cool water so they do not continue cooking. 4. Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Add the shrimp and cook for about 2 minutes per side until pink and nearly cooked through. 6. Add half of the minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. 7. Cook for another 30–60 seconds, then remove the shrimp from the heat. 8. Chop the shrimp into smaller pieces and allow it to cool slightly. 9. In a large bowl, combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, 1/2 cup mozzarella, Italian seasoning, and fresh parsley. 10. Fold the cooked shrimp into the cheese mixture until evenly distributed. 11. Melt the cream cheese into the heavy cream in a saucepan over medium-low heat. 12. Add the remaining minced garlic and stir until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 13. Stir in the lemon juice and a small pinch of salt and black pepper. 14. Spread a thin layer of the creamy garlic sauce across the bottom of a baking dish. 15. Fill each pasta shell generously with the shrimp and cheese mixture. 16. Arrange the stuffed shells in the dish and pour the remaining Alfredo sauce over and around them. 17. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 18. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. 19. Remove the foil and bake for another 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. 20. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot with extra creamy sauce spooned over the shells. Follow this account for more creamy, cheesy recipes that taste like restaurant favorites at home.

Recipe Name Slow Roasted Glazed Beef Chuck Roast Ingredients 1. 3–4 lb beef chuck roast 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tsp kosher salt 4. 1 1/2 tsp black pepper 5. 2 tsp garlic powder 6. 1 tsp onion powder 7. 1 tsp smoked paprika 8. 1 tsp dried thyme 9. 1/2 tsp dried rosemary 10. 5 cloves garlic, minced 11. 1 medium yellow onion, sliced 12. 1 cup beef broth 13. 1/2 cup barbecue sauce 14. 1/4 cup honey 15. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 16. 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 17. 1 tbsp brown sugar 18. 2 tbsp butter Recipe 1. Remove the beef roast from the refrigerator and pat it dry. 2. Combine the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, thyme, and rosemary. 3. Rub the seasoning generously over the entire roast. 4. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or roasting pan over medium-high heat. 5. Sear the roast on all sides until deeply browned and caramelized. 6. Transfer the roast to a baking or roasting pan if needed. 7. Scatter the sliced onion and minced garlic around the beef. 8. Whisk together the beef broth, barbecue sauce, honey, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, and brown sugar. 9. Pour the sauce around the roast, keeping most of the glaze on the surface of the beef. 10. Dot the top with butter and cover the pan tightly with foil or a lid. 11. Place the roast in a preheated 325°F (165°C) oven. 12. Roast slowly until the beef becomes fork-tender and can be pulled apart easily. 13. Carefully remove the cover and spoon the pan juices over the roast. 14. Increase the oven temperature to 400°F (200°C) and return the uncovered roast to the oven. 15. Baste the roast several times with the thickened pan juices until the exterior becomes glossy, dark, and caramelized. 16. Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 15–20 minutes. 17. Slice the roast against the grain or pull it apart into tender pieces. 18. Spoon the caramelized glaze and pan juices over the sliced beef before serving. Creamy Tuscan White Beans Ingredients (4-5 servings): • 2 (15-oz) cans white beans, Great Northern or cannellini, drained and rinsed • 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved • ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped • 1 small yellow onion, finely diced • 4 garlic cloves, finely minced • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, plus more to taste • 1 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups broth • ½ cup whole milk • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • ½ cup finely grated Parmesan, plus more for serving • 2–3 cups chopped kale, tough stems removed • 1 tbsp lemon juice • 1 tsp honey • ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper • Salt, to taste • Extra-virgin olive oil, for finishing • Crusty sourdough, for serving Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil and diced onion with a pinch of salt. Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. 2. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they’re blistered and beginning to collapse. Reserve some of the blistered tomatoes for later. 3. Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.  4. Stir in Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes and black pepper. 5. Sprinkle flour over everything and stir for about 30 seconds. Slowly pour in the broth while stirring, followed by the milk and Dijon mustard. 6. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened. 7. Stir in the beans and simmer gently for 5–7 minutes.  8. Mash about ⅓ of the beans against the side of the skillet with the back of a spoon. 9. Stir in the chopped kale, cover, and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring once or twice, until tender but still vibrant. 10. Lower the heat and stir in the Parmesan until melted and glossy. 11. Add lemon juice and honey. Taste and adjust salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. If the sauce is thicker than you want, stir in a splash of broth. 12. Top with the reserved blistered tomatoes, Parmesan, black pepper and a drizzle of olive oil. Enjoy! #beans #whitebeans #fallrecipes #easydinner #dinneridea

Классический проверенный рецепт тонких блинчиков на молоке, по которому они получаются нежными, эластичными и не рвутся при жарке. 🛒 Ингредиенты • Молоко (комнатной температуры) — 500 мл • Яйца — 3 шт. • Мука пшеничная — 200 г (примерно 1,5 стакана) • Сахар — 2 ст. л. (можно регулировать по вкусу) • Растительное масло — 2 ст. л. (в тесто) • Соль — 0,5 ч. л. 🍳 Пошаговое приготовление 1. Смешайте основу: В глубокой миске взбейте венчиком яйца с сахаром и солью до однородности. 2. Добавьте часть молока: Влейте примерно 150-200 мл молока и перемешайте. Если влить все молоко сразу, в тесте образуются комочки. 3. Всыпьте муку: Просейте муку в миску и тщательно замесите венчиком густое однородное тесто без комков. 4. Разведите тесто: Постепенно влейте оставшееся молоко, постоянно помешивая. Добавьте растительное масло и снова перемешайте. Тесто получится довольно жидким — так и должно быть для тонких блинов. 5. Дайте тесту «отдохнуть»: Оставьте тесто при комнатной температуре на 20–30 минут. За это время клейковина в муке расслабится, и блинчики не будут рваться при переворачивании. 6. Пожарьте блинчики: Тщательно раскалите сковороду. Перед первым блином смажьте её каплей масла. Налейте небольшое количество теста на сковороду, быстро вращая её по кругу, чтобы оно распределилось тонким слоем. Жарьте на среднем огне 1–2 минуты до золотистых краев, затем переверните и готовьте еще 30–40 секунд. 💡 Совет: Готовые горячие блинчики можно складывать стопкой на тарелку, смазывая каждый кусочком сливочного масла для мягкости.
